content: We must be very suspicious of the pretenses of the world to help us.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Relying on external institutions, social approval, or paternalistic promises weakens the individual's native resolve and independent self-mastery.
practicalInsight: Solve a problem with your own ingenuity and hard labor today before seeking outside rescue.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you become overly dependent on external support rather than your own capabilities?
